node_notes.i2c: I2C1 is the shared bus initialized and scanned during application startup. Its SCL and SDA bindings are PB8 and PB9, configured for I2C1 alternate function 6 in the STM32 bus adapter.
node_notes.console: The ST-LINK Virtual COM Port is the serial output sink for application logs and climate frames. The UART adapter sends both data paths through USART2.
node_notes.dht: The DHT22 supplies the climate reading through its single-wire data line on PB4. The app configuration assigns PB4 to DHT22 data, and the STM32 adapter reads and drives that line using HAL GPIO calls.
node_notes.app: app_start coordinates I2C initialization and scanning, climate service setup, and the continuous climate polling loop. It also reports readings and failures using the logger and sends valid climate frames through platform_uart2_write.
node_notes.dhtport: The STM32 DHT22 adapter switches PB4 between open-drain output and input, captures timed pulses, and passes the frame to the decoder. It uses TIM3 for microsecond timing and exposes climate_port_init and climate_port_read to the service.
node_notes.uart: USART2 carries both formatted climate frames and logs to the board's ST-LINK Virtual COM Port. Its adapter configures PA2 and PA3 as USART2 pins and transmits with HAL_UART_Transmit at the configured 115200 baud.
node_notes.climate: The climate service initializes the platform port and enforces the configured two-second minimum interval between readings. It calls the DHT22 port and returns decoded values or a mapped acquisition status to the app.
node_notes.uartport: The USART2 platform adapter initializes the UART and transmits supplied bytes with HAL_UART_Transmit. It serves both the logger bridge and the app's formatted climate-frame output.
node_notes.i2cport: The STM32 I2C1 adapter configures PB8 and PB9, initializes I2C1, and provides the scan used during startup. Its HAL operations include HAL_I2C_Init and HAL_I2C_IsDeviceReady.
node_notes.logger: The portable logger formats tagged messages before forwarding them through logger_platform_write. Its platform bridge sends those messages through the USART2 adapter.
node_notes.tim3: TIM3 provides the free-running microsecond counter used to measure DHT22 response and bit pulse timing. The platform adapter initializes and starts it with HAL timer calls.

sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Main as Core main
  participant App as app_start
  participant I2C as I2C1 bus adapter
  participant Climate as climate_service
  participant DHTPort as DHT22 platform adapter
  participant DHT as DHT22 on PB4
  participant Timer as TIM3
  participant Logger as logger
  participant UART as USART2 adapter
  participant Console as ST-LINK Virtual COM Port
  Main->>App: app_start()
  App->>I2C: i2c_bus_init()
  alt I2C initialization fails
    App->>Logger: LOGE initialization failure
    Logger->>UART: logger_platform_write()
    UART->>Console: HAL_UART_Transmit log
    App-->>Main: return from app_start()
  else I2C initialization succeeds
    App->>I2C: i2c_bus_scan()
    I2C-->>App: acknowledged addresses and probe count
    App->>Climate: climate_service_init()
    alt Climate port initialization fails
      App->>Logger: LOGE initialization failure
      Logger->>UART: logger_platform_write()
      UART->>Console: HAL_UART_Transmit log
      loop Fatal initialization spin
        App->>App: remain in infinite loop
      end
    else Climate port initializes
      App->>Logger: LOGI sampling started
      Logger->>UART: logger_platform_write()
      UART->>Console: HAL_UART_Transmit log
      loop Climate polling; minimum interval 2000 ms
        App->>Climate: climate_service_poll()
        Climate->>DHTPort: climate_port_read()
        DHTPort->>DHT: drive and release PB4#59; capture response and data
        DHTPort->>Timer: read TIM3 counter for pulse timing
        DHT-->>DHTPort: DHT22 response and 40 data bits
        DHTPort-->>Climate: decoded reading or port error
        alt Climate reading valid
          App->>Logger: LOGI temperature and humidity
          Logger->>UART: logger_platform_write()
          UART->>Console: HAL_UART_Transmit log
          App->>UART: platform_uart2_write climate frame
          UART->>Console: HAL_UART_Transmit climate frame
        else Climate read failed
          App->>Logger: LOGE read failure
          Logger->>UART: logger_platform_write()
          UART->>Console: HAL_UART_Transmit log
        end
      end
    end
  end
